description: Current compiler import and ownership boundaries expressed by behavior rather than planning references.

forbidden: target rendering, hook wiring, frontmatter emission, or lock formatting

boundaries.responsibility: Define the target-neutral lifecycle and result shapes.
forbidden: manifest, profile, conflict, contribution, and anchor loaders

forbidden: manifest, profile, conflict, contribution, and anchor loaders

allowed: backend base, degradation, and enforcement helpers
forbidden: manifest, profile, conflict, contribution, and anchor loaders

boundaries.responsibility: Own Codex plugin rendering, user-hook installation, lock, writes, and lifecycle.
allowed: backend degradation, enforcement, and YAML helpers
forbidden: manifest, profile, conflict, contribution, and anchor loaders

boundaries.responsibility: Assemble capability records and derive status flags without I/O.
Provide shared deterministic matcher and lease-source builders.
Serialize the closed emitted YAML subset deterministically.
Parse commands, select targets, and dispatch neutral composition or lifecycle calls.
allowed: IR public entry points and neutral profile operations
forbidden: private manifest, conflict, contribution, or anchor loaders

boundaries.responsibility: Build and verify generated artifacts from product source.
allowed: compiler public APIs where generation requires emission
forbidden: runtime coupling from product modules back into tools

boundaries.responsibility: Ship a verbatim, standard-library-only compiler bundle and freshness companion.
allowed: imports within the vendored system2_compiler package

boundaries.responsibility: Exercise public compiler behavior, generated artifacts, and explicit negative controls.
allowed: compiler public and intentionally tested internal APIs
frozen composer only through the oracle subprocess adapter
forbidden: product imports from plugin composer, profiles, or hook-security modules

global_invariants: IR and backend product modules use only the Python standard library.
Product modules introduce no network calls or telemetry.
Backends receive composition data through System2Graph and own only target locks and artifacts.
The IR contains no target rendering or hook-wiring logic.
Every graph capability appears in the owning target descriptor and emitted report.
Pi and Codex render from structured graph fields rather than Claude byte-fidelity carriers.
Every backend writes only beneath project_path except the explicit, user-invoked Codex hook installation lifecycle.
Generated bundle and distribution trees are refreshed through regen_all.py rather than hand-edited.
The plugin adapter pins its target to Claude Code and preserves the existing composer command contract.
